description: Executable Candidate llama.cpp recipe based on NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model card (llama.cpp section, flags -c 40960 -ngl 99 -fa on --jinja --no-webui --fit off) and the ggml-org GGUF it links: the official ggml-org llama.cpp 0.5.0 CUDA 13 server image (arm64, pinned by digest; its default CUDA architectures include GB10 sm_121a) serving the exact GGUF revision through llama-server. NVIDIA's llama.cpp playbook compiles the same upstream source with -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=121a-real; this recipe uses the project's published binary instead. Resource envelopes are estimates, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Q4_0 llama.cpp single Spark (NVIDIA model card)
